comment: Don't have much work at all for B+, lil more for A-, but getting an A is hard. Does not give clear feedback, and if you have a question about the feedback it will offend him. People that spend 2 hrs & 12 hrs will often get the same grade, even if the difference in effort is apparent. No extra credit. Avoid this FYS at all costs if you want an A.

Often provides feedback that ends up lowering your grade and makes you spend about $60 on books you will only use once. Not too much work but do not expect an A unless you really suck up to him and laugh at all his jokes.

Every grade was weighted heavily on a subjective basis w/ no ExCr or points back. Midterm material contradicted grading criteria which pissed me off. If you're happy w an easy class getting lower than A, take it. If you want to work and actually earn your grade, hard work isn't rewarded in this class. Critical rating, but reflective of his grading

One of the most useless and unhelpful professors ever. He is very misleading with his recommendations. He is not helpful outside classes and also does not have the right facts when he teaches which is really disappointing.
His really not a good teacher, not reasonable at all. Try to avoid him in the future.
The course was useful however he is not really good at teaching it and I would be looking to avoid him in the future and would suggest others to do the same.
Very nice guy! And he's extremely helpful. If you do your work well you'll get a good grade.
Very nice guy! And he's extremely helpful. I'd definitely recommend him.
Amazing guy...really quirky but so helpful and such a great teacher..if you're a finance major, definitely take him

Fishe is a nice guy, but he is not a clear teacher. A lot of the time I didn't have a clue what he was talking about in class, and had to later teach myself out of the textbook . The tests were reasonable, but the final was hard. Arnold substituted one day and was much more clear.
